items.question: How does MultiPost work?
items.answer: MultiPost is a browser extension that uses your existing social media logins to post content. No additional authentication or API keys needed.

items.question: What platforms are supported?
items.answer: We currently support Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Instagram and more. The list grows with community contributions.

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes! MultiPost is completely free and open source. You can use all features without limitations.

items.question: How can I contribute?
items.answer: You can contribute by starring the repository, reporting issues, submitting pull requests, or improving documentation.
